{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Student debt is holding millions of Americans back.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The COVID-19 pandemic and President Trump's recession are making it harder for those with student loans to make ends meet right now.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for authorizing up to $10,000 in student debt relief per borrower to help families weather this crisis.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for taking steps to ease the burden of high monthly student loan payments through legislative and administration relief processes, including creating a simplified repayment process.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for pausing monthly billing and stopping interest from accruing on federal student loans for people earning less than $25,000.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for capping payments at no more than five percent of discretionary income for those earning more than $25,000.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for automatically forgiving remaining federal student loan debt after 20 years without tax liability.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for forgiving all undergraduate tuition-related federal student debt from two- and four-year public colleges and universities for those earning less than $125,000.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for applying the benefit of forgiving undergraduate tuition-related federal student debt to individuals holding federal student loans from private HBCUs and MSIs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
